user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for ChatGPT search answers; does not affect navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads; not used for model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content potentially used to train OpenAI generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetch web pages for user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered requests and GPT Actions; not used for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to enhance AI model utility and training.
user_agents.scope: Gathers data from the public web for generative AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to exclude future content from model training.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated requests and queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent retrieving content for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent indexing content for search optimization.
